messages:
anna: Quick UX check after usability session. A couple of users got confused by the 'Snooze until' control when they changed timezones — the preview still showed local time but the rule stored UTC. We need clearer timezone affordance. michael: Repro: set snooze to 'tomorrow 9:00' while on PST, travel to CET, reopen rule -> preview says 9:00 but is actually shifted. That's scary. rachel: Two fixes: 1) show both local and stored timezone in the preview row (e.g., '09:00 PST — stored as 17:00 UTC'), 2) add a small info icon with tooltip explaining stored timezone behavior. I prefer #1 for transparency. owen: UX tradeoff: dual-time labels add visual noise to compact alert cards. We could collapse the stored timezone behind the tooltip and surface a timezone abbreviation next to the time (click to expand). anna: Mock here: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/snooze-tz — compact label with small "UTC" pill that expands on hover. I also changed the microcopy from 'Snooze until' to 'Silence until' based on session language — people said 'snooze' sounded temporary but 'silence' matched expectations for rule-level pause. michael: Accessibility note: the tooltip must be accessible (focusable, dismissible via Esc). Also the UTC pill needs aria-expanded/aria-controls if it toggles details. accessbot: Accessibility scan results (thread 2345678901): 1) tooltip lacks role="dialog" and keyboard dismiss; 2) UTC pill missing aria-expanded state; 3) color differentiation used alone in priority badges (fails contrast in high-contrast mode). rachel: For the priority badges, suggestion: use ordinal text ("1st", "2nd") + color. That solves color-only issue and helps localization folks. ownen: Also, the alert preview currently shows channel icons only. Some users with low vision missed which channel was which when icon spacing was tight. Suggest add channel label text inline on hover, and in compact mode show first two letters of channel name as a text fallback. anna: Copy tweak: current helper under the preview reads 'Preview may differ from live routing.' That's vague. Proposed: 'Preview shows the final notify order. Live routing may select a fallback channel if the primary is unavailable.' Short and actionable. michael: Implementation concern: adding extra DOM for dual-time and ordinals could bloat the render path for lists with many rules. Let's keep SSR-friendly markup and hide extras behind aria-expanded so screenreaders still get the info without rendering heavy visuals. rachel: Quick aria suggestion: on the preview container add aria-live="polite" so when a user changes priority the screenreader announces 'Channel order updated: email first, slack second'. ownen: I can prototype a lightweight DOM structure: ```html
Silence until 09:00 UTC
Stored as 17:00 UTC
#1 1st · Email
``` anna: Action list: 1) @rachel will update copy and aria-live phrasing, 2) @owen will mock compact fallback (two-letter channel) + ordinals, 3) @michael will add keyboard/tooltip policy and e2e for timezone toggles. I'll also run a short user test with 5 participants on Tuesday. michael: I'll also run unit tests verifying aria-expanded toggles and that tooltip is dismissed on Esc. accessbot: Reminder: please re-run automated checks after changes. Also note contrast token suggestions available in /design-tokens/accessible-colors. anna: Great, thanks. I'll drop the updated frames and ping here when ready. :raised_hands:
